pages.title: Fractions on a Number Line — Greater Than 1
pages.subject: Math
pages.directions: Use the example on the class paper first. Count the equal spaces in one whole and the steps to X. Keep the denominator shown by the line.

items.prompt: What improper fraction is marked by X?
hints: Count the equal spaces from 0 to 1 for the denominator.
Start at 0 and count the spaces up to the marked tick for the numerator.
show: Each whole has 3 equal parts, and the marked tick is 4 steps from zero.
Write 4/3.
items.explain: There are 3 equal steps per whole and 4 steps from 0 to the marked tick.
items.retry: Count spaces between tick marks. Count only the spaces from 0 to 1 for the denominator.

pages.title: Cherries: Good to Eat and Good for You Too!
pages.subject: Reading
pages.directions: Open the class passage and read aloud three times. A grown-up records words read right and errors. Follow the teacher’s timing directions.

fluency.title: Cherries: Good to Eat and Good for You Too!

pages.title: Cherries — Comprehension Questions
pages.subject: Reading
pages.directions: Read the class cherries passage. Restate each question and answer in a complete sentence. Review the meaning with a grown-up.

items.prompt: What do you think the word versatile means?
items.example: Versatile means that something can be used in many different ways.
hints: Restate the question in a complete sentence.
Look for the different ways people use cherries.
show: Compare your response with this example.
Versatile means that something can be used in many different ways.
items.yes: Compare your answer with a grown-up.
items.explain: A grown-up checks your meaning and the details you used from the passage.

items.prompt: What are some of the health benefits of tart cherries?
items.example: According to the passage, tart cherries contain vitamin A and are believed to help relieve the pain of gout and arthritis.
hints: Restate the question in a complete sentence.
Find the sentences about tart cherries and health benefits.
show: Compare your response with this example.
According to the passage, tart cherries contain vitamin A and are believed to help relieve the pain of gout and arthritis.
items.yes: Compare your answer with a grown-up.
items.explain: A grown-up checks your meaning and the details you used from the passage.
